h1: Squarespace SEO and speed, cleaner and lighter
overview: We work through the settings and structure that decide how Squarespace sites show up in search and how fast they load. That means page titles and descriptions, heading order, URL slugs, image names and alt text, redirects, structured data and Search Console. For speed, we shrink oversized images, trim heavy blocks and scripts and check mobile load times, then share before and after numbers. We cannot promise ranking positions.

How do you speed up a Squarespace site?
Mostly with image sizes, fewer heavy blocks, lighter fonts and removing unused scripts. Squarespace controls its own servers, so we cannot change those, but we can fix what you add on top.
